Z głębokim smutkiem zawiadamiamy, że ostatnie ziemskie pożegnanie naszego Kolegi, Przyjaciela, Przewodniczącego... naszego Witka odbędzie się w piątek 18 września.

▪️O godzinie 11:oo odbędzie się nabożeństwo żałobne w Kościele Rzymskokatolickim Środowisk Twórczych pw. św. Andrzeja Apostoła i Brata Alberta, przy Placu Teatralnym 18 w Warszawie
▪️O godzinie 13:oo nastąpi uroczyste odprowadzenie, które rozpocznie się przy bramie Cmentarza Wojskowego na Powązkach od strony ulicy Powązkowskiej 43/45.

Rodzina prosi aby zamiast kwiatów wesprzeć wskazaną Fundację, o której informacje przekażemy niebawem. Datki będzie można przekazać do puszek przed kościołem oraz na cmentarzu. Dziękujemy.

/fot. Łukasz "Dziadek" Skwara, z planu "Idź przodem, bracie", 2023"/

🎭👩‍👧DZIECIĘCY AKTORZY🤞🎬
## **Dzień dobry!**

Nazywam się Katarzyna Maria Zawadzka. Jestem aktorką oraz trenerką aktorstwa i wystąpień publicznych. 

Wspieram dzieci i młodzież w wieku szkoklnym w przygotowaniu do:

castingów filmowych i reklamowych, konkursów aktorskich, wystąpień publicznych wymagających świadomej autoprezentacji.

Pomagam również w przygotowaniu profesjonalnych wizytówek aktorskich zgodnych z aktualnymi standardami branżowymi oraz w nagrywaniu scen castingowych (self-tape). Prowadzę także regularne lekcje aktorstwa. 

Spotkania z podopiecznymi odbywają się w trybie ON-LINE.

W swojej pracy wspieram również rodziców i opiekunów, zwłaszcza tych, którzy nie są związani z branżą filmową lub teatralną. Pomagam świadomie planować rozwój kariery młodych aktorek i aktorów, podpowiadam, jak odnaleźć się podczas castingów, na jakiej podstawie podejmować trafne decyzje dotyczące współpracy z agencjami i produkcjami oraz jak rozpoznawać potencjalne zagrożenia związane z działalnością w branży.

Brałam udział jako trenerka dziecięcych aktorów przy realizacji między innymi wielokrotnie nagradzanego na festiwalach filmu krótkometrażowego pt.: „Iron Cloud” w reżyserii Nikodema Wojciechowskiego.

Zapraszam do kontaktu! Chętnie odpowiem na pytania i opowiem o możliwościach współpracy dostosowanych do indywidualnych potrzeb młodych aktorów i ich rodziców

Kontakt:
# E-mail: kmzawadzkatrener@gmail.com

[https://www.facebook.com/KMZawadzka](https://www.facebook.com/KMZawadzka)

❗️✨Szukamy aktorów do studenckiego projektu filmu krótkometrażowego Szkoły Filmowej im. Krzysztofa Kieślowskiego w Katowicach.✨❗️

Film opowiada historię architekta (MARCEL), który zaniedbuje swoje życie ze względu na samotność. Śni więc o związku z kobietą, która nie istnieje, aby zaspokoić w sobie potrzebę miłości. Przy pracy nad projektem poznaje jednak ALICJĘ, z którą zaczyna się coraz bardziej lubić, a o którą jego wyśniona partnerka robi się zazdrosna. 

Szukamy osób do ról:

- MARCEL (30-35 lat): Introwertyk z wyboru. Pogrążony od kilku lat w samotności człowiek, który skupia się na pracy, żeby zapomnieć o udręce życia codziennego. Termin zdjęć: 24-28 września.
- ALICJA (28-33 lat): Społeczna i wiecznie uśmiechnięta niespełniona artystka, która lubi bawić się życiem. Termin zdjęć: 26-27 września.

Produkcja jest studencka, więc nie jesteśmy w stanie zaoferować więcej, niż symboliczne wynagrodzenie, dobra atmosfera, legendarny potencjał festiwalowy i zwrot kosztów za dojazd. Zdjęcia w Katowicach. Zgłoszenia prosimy wysyłać na adres: bozekochamrobicfilmy@gmail.com

🎬 **STATISTER SØGES TIL KIRKEOPTAGELSE (ULØNNET)**

Kortfilmen *IRIS* søger statister i alle aldre til en vigtig bisættelsesscene.

📅 **OPTAGELSESDATOER**

**Fredag d. 18/09**
🕣 Kl. 08.30–13.00

**Søndag d. 20/09**
🕘 Kl. 09.15–15.45

📍 **Vestre Kirkegårds Allé 15, 2450 København SV**

🍽️ **Vi sørger for forplejning!**

🎥 **OM FILMEN**

*IRIS* zoomer ind på tab i en alt for tidlig alder og et ungt menneskes opgør med overbeskyttende forældre.

Scenen foregår til bisættelsen af hovedkarakteren **ALBERTs** bedste veninde, **NAJA**, som mistede livet under et ukontrolleret studentergilde.

🎭 **DIN ROLLE SOM STATIST**

Det er en statistrolle med tilstedeværelse og reaktioner.

Albert afbryder bisættelsen og går akavet op til alteret for at afholde en tale. Jeres reaktioner vil være essentielle for publikums oplevelse af hans handling.

Nogle af jer skal:
• Hviske lidt i krogene
• Grine
• Blive rørt af ærligheden i Alberts ord

👀 Derudover er det under bisættelsen, at et stort plottwist finder sted!

📩 **INTERESSERET?**

Skriv til mig på mail:
**[martinturcot@gmail.com](mailto:martinturcot@gmail.com)**

Du er også meget velkommen til at skrive til mig på PB.

Glæder mig til at høre fra jer! 🙌

**God energi ud til jer alle <3**

Martin Turcot
*Statistkoordinator, IRIS*

THRILLER-MUSICAL: AUDITION I WEEKENDEN!Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere samt dansere af alle køn!

Auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 12.-13. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

Læs mere om audition og tilmeld dig her: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Happy Monday guys.

My name is Rebecca Walshe and im 27 years old almost 28. I am an Actress and creative based within the West Midlands not to far from Birmingham. 

I’d love to get involved in any projects you have available in the future and especially with Halloween coming up I’d love to do some scare acting or work on a horror project.

I’m also passionate about anything to do with the circus my ground act and currently working on in LED POI’s but I also love aerial hoop which I’m also still working on.

I also love singing a musical theatre 🎭 

I’m also looking to network with people who have similar interests to me.

Hello there, everybody how are you all doing? My name is Sean McLean. I’m an actor a model and a musician.

I’ve been within this industry for almost a decade. I’ve worked all around the world with various different agencies as well as brands campaigns, feature films, Short films and commercials. I’ve walked in London Fashion week on multiple occasions.

I also make and compose music, I just recently had a film producer by one of my songs for their upcoming feature film. 

All of my extensive details are included here on my portfolio links and my Spotlight. 

Rates and inquiries included on portfolio.

sharedPost.text:
ATELIERS THÉÂTRE - ADULTES

Quand ?
Tous les samedis matins de 10h à 12h

Où ?
Au TNR, 3-5 rue Péan, 75013 Paris // Métro : Porte d’Ivry (Ligne 7)

Combien ?
180€ par trimestre + 10€ d’adhésion.
Il est possible d’avoir un tarif préférentiel selon votre quotient familial (égal ou inférieur au QF4).

Le cours d’essai est gratuit !

Inscriptions, contactez Andréa : 06 32 07 69 48 // andrea.fulconis2@gmail.com

DESCRIPTIF

Le cours est ouvert à tous les adultes de 18 à 99 ans, désireux de rencontrer - ou de re-rencontrer - le théâtre.

- L’année sera divisée en deux parties - 

De septembre à décembre, nous travaillerons les outils du comédien par le biais d’exercices et d’improvisations (seul, à plusieurs, ou en collectif). Nous aborderons le corps et la voix de l’acteur, mais aussi son rapport à l’espace, à l’autre, au public, au silence... À travers cette recherche préliminaire, nous souderons le groupe. Le collectif sera notre maître-mot : c’est ensemble que l’on apprendra et que l’on grandira au plateau. L’objectif étant de monter une pièce ensemble durant la deuxième partie de l’année.

De janvier à juin, nous monterons, en effet, un spectacle à partir d’un texte d’auteur. Classique ou contemporain, comique ou tragique, nous trouverons l’auteur qui vous fait envie, la langue que vous voulez porter, l’histoire que vous voulez défendre ! Nous entamerons, alors, un travail précis d’interprétation du texte et de personnages, à travers une mise en scène crée sur mesure pour votre groupe. Un langage commun et une esthétique propre à la création nous rassemblera.

Plusieurs représentations sont prévues à la fin de l’année : nous jouerons notre pièce plusieurs fois devant un public bienveillant !

LA PROF - Andréa Fulconis

En parallèle d’un Master de Littérature Française à La Sorbonne, Andréa se forme aux Conservatoires d’Art Dramatique (CRD de Cannes, CRR de Nice et CRD de Bobigny). Puis, elle intègre l’École Internationale de Théâtre Jacques Lecoq, célèbre école de jeu corporel. Enfin, elle intègre la LUDI (Ligue Universitaire d’improvisation d’Île-de-France) et se perfectionne en improvisation.

Elle travaille, par la suite, pour plusieurs compagnies d’île-de-France en tant que comédienne, improvisatrice et metteuse en scène, comme Tonnerre de Singe, La Mazane ou Les Loups-Graou, qui sont tout autant d’espaces et des foyers de création lui permettant de développer sa recherche artistique.

La pédagogie prend également une place importante dans sa vie puisqu’elle est professeure de théâtre et d’improvisation pour la Cie Maya, la Ludo Impro’, La Mazane, et désormais au TNR, pour la Compagnie Tonnerre de Singe

Riche de toutes ces expériences, Andréa mêle, dans ses cours de théâtre, un travail précis de texte - hérité de sa formation classique - à une recherche vivante et corporelle, telle qu’elle s’en est emparée par la suite dans son travail artistique. Ses cours sont, pour elle, un espace de recherche à part entière, au même titre qu’une création professionnelle.

🎙️ RECHERCHE DE VOIX – FICTION AUDIO BÉNÉVOLE 🎙️
Bonjour à tous !

Dans le cadre de ma fiction audio Peter Ayrton : Les Mystères du Monde – La Lance de Seth, je recherche encore plusieurs comédiens et comédiennes pour compléter le casting des derniers épisodes.

Il s’agit d’une fiction audio d’aventure pulp et fantastique située dans les années 1930, mêlant archéologie, espionnage, sociétés secrètes, mythologies anciennes et surnaturel. Trois épisodes sont déjà sortis sur les sept prévus pour ce premier volume, et la suite est actuellement en production.

Les rôles encore disponibles sont :

* Anubis : dieu du Conseil des dieux du Monde des Morts. Personnage strict, autoritaire et imposant. Voix masculine grave et théâtrale. Environ 10 répliques.

* Jean : membre d’Hermès, sérieux et discret. Voix masculine médium et naturelle. Environ 6 répliques.

* Agent Michel : agent de Cupidon, ferme, direct et militaire. Voix masculine médium. Environ 6 répliques.

* Supérieur de Cupidon : responsable haut placé au sein de l’organisation, très autoritaire. Voix masculine grave. 2 à 4 répliques.

* Georges : client aristocrate d’un hôtel. Voix masculine distinguée. 1 réplique.

* Isabelle : cliente aristocrate, élégante et plutôt outrée par la situation. Voix féminine distinguée, éventuellement légèrement hautaine. Environ 3 répliques.

* Soldat : très petit rôle militaire. Voix masculine ferme et autoritaire. 1 réplique.

* Fléau 1 et Fléau 2 : créatures démoniaques de la tentation, manipulatrices et malsaines. Je recherche des voix sifflantes, inquiétantes, presque reptiliennes, avec une manière de parler évoquant des serpents. Environ 4 à 5 répliques chacun.

* Chœur des âmes damnées : 4 voix recherchées pour incarner les fantômes et âmes prisonnières de la Prison des Damnés. Voix spectrales, plaintives, accusatrices ou menaçantes, qui seront notamment superposées au mixage.

Le projet est bénévole et non rémunéré. Tous les niveaux sont acceptés, avec de préférence un micro correct et la possibilité d’enregistrer à distance.

⚠️ Il est nécessaire d’avoir Discord et d’être actif dessus, car toute l’organisation du projet se fait sur le serveur : échanges avec l’équipe, scripts, indications de jeu, retours et suivi des enregistrements.

👉 Serveur Discord : https://discord.gg/qd5vxMqJ7p

La plupart des rôles sont assez courts et rapides à enregistrer. Même si vous aviez déjà candidaté auparavant pour l’un de ces rôles, vous pouvez tout à fait vous reproposer.

Si un rôle vous intéresse, vous pouvez me contacter en MP avec une petite présentation, le rôle qui vous tente et, si possible, une bande démo ou quelques exemples de votre voix.

Merci beaucoup pour vos partages ! 🎧

🎙️ RECHERCHE DE VOIX – FICTION AUDIO BÉNÉVOLE 🎙️
Bonjour à tous !

Dans le cadre de ma fiction audio Peter Ayrton : Les Mystères du Monde – La Lance de Seth, je recherche encore plusieurs comédiens et comédiennes pour compléter le casting des derniers épisodes.

Il s’agit d’une fiction audio d’aventure pulp et fantastique située dans les années 1930, mêlant archéologie, espionnage, sociétés secrètes, mythologies anciennes et surnaturel. Trois épisodes sont déjà sortis sur les sept prévus pour ce premier volume, et la suite est actuellement en production.

Les rôles encore disponibles sont :

* Anubis : dieu du Conseil des dieux du Monde des Morts. Personnage strict, autoritaire et imposant. Voix masculine grave et théâtrale. Environ 10 répliques.

* Jean : membre d’Hermès, sérieux et discret. Voix masculine médium et naturelle. Environ 6 répliques.

* Agent Michel : agent de Cupidon, ferme, direct et militaire. Voix masculine médium. Environ 6 répliques.

* Supérieur de Cupidon : responsable haut placé au sein de l’organisation, très autoritaire. Voix masculine grave. 2 à 4 répliques.

* Georges : client aristocrate d’un hôtel. Voix masculine distinguée. 1 réplique.

* Isabelle : cliente aristocrate, élégante et plutôt outrée par la situation. Voix féminine distinguée, éventuellement légèrement hautaine. Environ 3 répliques.

* Soldat : très petit rôle militaire. Voix masculine ferme et autoritaire. 1 réplique.

* Fléau 1 et Fléau 2 : créatures démoniaques de la tentation, manipulatrices et malsaines. Je recherche des voix sifflantes, inquiétantes, presque reptiliennes, avec une manière de parler évoquant des serpents. Environ 4 à 5 répliques chacun.

* Chœur des âmes damnées : 4 voix recherchées pour incarner les fantômes et âmes prisonnières de la Prison des Damnés. Voix spectrales, plaintives, accusatrices ou menaçantes, qui seront notamment superposées au mixage.

Le projet est bénévole et non rémunéré. Tous les niveaux sont acceptés, avec de préférence un micro correct et la possibilité d’enregistrer à distance.

⚠️ Il est nécessaire d’avoir Discord et d’être actif dessus, car toute l’organisation du projet se fait sur le serveur : échanges avec l’équipe, scripts, indications de jeu, retours et suivi des enregistrements.

👉 Serveur Discord : https://discord.gg/qd5vxMqJ7p

La plupart des rôles sont assez courts et rapides à enregistrer. Même si vous aviez déjà candidaté auparavant pour l’un de ces rôles, vous pouvez tout à fait vous reproposer.

Si un rôle vous intéresse, vous pouvez me contacter en MP avec une petite présentation, le rôle qui vous tente et, si possible, une bande démo ou quelques exemples de votre voix.

Merci beaucoup pour vos partages ! 🎧

NCLH Shows & Experiences is seeking male and female identifying aerialists for the all-new productions aboard NCL's newest ship, the Norwegian AURA

📍 Las Vegas, NV

📅 Tuesday, September 22, 2026

Pre-registration is required. Selected applicants will receive an email with audition location, audition time, and additional audition details.

Please visit aerialists.castingcrane.com to submit!

Contract Details:

Director/Choreographers: Kevin and Marcel Wilson

Rehearsals begin November 9, 2026 in Tampa

Holiday Break: December 20, 2026 to January 10, 2027

Board the Norwegian Aura on or about February 22, 2027

End of contract TBD 6-8 months onboard

Itinerary: Mediterranean and Caribbean

***All dates subject to change.***

Rehearsal: $700/week

Onboard: $1,350/week ($5,850/month)

All cast members are provided with a single occupancy cabin onboard. Cast will be Crew Members onboard with no cruise staff duties outside of the performance schedule. Travel provided to Tampa, to the vessel, and home at the end of the contract.

PERFORMANCE DESCRIPTION:

Seeking aerialists for original main stage productions debuting onboard Norwegian Cruise Line’s newest vessel, the Norwegian AURA. One show will be a concert/Las Vegas residency-style experience centered around a well-known artist’s musical legacy. This brand-new “Concert Show” will follow in the footsteps of Revolution: A Celebration of Prince on the Norwegian AQUA and Elton: A Celebration of Elton John on the Norwegian LUNA.

ROLE BREAKDOWN:

AERIALISTS: Any ethnicity. Male and female identifying. Athletic, dynamic, versatile artists with expertise in a wide range of skills including Silks, Straps, Bungee, Cube, Hand Balancing, and Acro. Must have upper body strength and physical presence. The ability to engage with an audience, embody a character, and tell a story is a must. Dance training and understanding of body lines and positions are a huge plus.

Must be 18 years or older to apply.

EKSTRA-AUDITION PÅ MUSICAL 🎭 
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu, hvor du også kan læse alle rollebeskrivelser: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere samt solister og dansere af alle køn! Samtlige pladser/roller i forestillingen er stadig åbne.

Nye auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 26.-27. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet samt dansere.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

🎭 YOUR ACTING TEACHER MIGHT BE HOLDING YOU BACK.
And you might not even realise it.

If you’ve been taking acting classes for months or even years, but you’re still struggling with your confidence, technique or ability to actually apply what you’re learning…

Your teacher might not be the right teacher for you.

⚠️ Here are 3 BIG red flags I’d pay VERY close attention to:

1. You’re performing scenes and receiving criticism, but you’re not being given the exercises and tools you need to actually improve your overall ability to act.

2. You’re doing exercises that have no clear logic or reasoning behind them, and you don’t understand how they translate to actual professional work.

3. You’re not seeing meaningful growth in your acting, which is holding you back from becoming the extraordinary actor you’re capable of becoming with the right training.

These are the kinds of red flags that can make you waste months (and thousands of dollars) on training that isn’t actually moving you forward.

🚨 But here’s the BIGGEST red flag:

An acting teacher who doesn’t help you develop the skills and understanding you need to actually BOOK WORK.

So I created the FREE Acting Teacher Blueprint.

Inside, I’ll show you exactly what to look for in your acting training and what kind of teacher can empower you to become an extraordinary actor who BOOKS THE ROLES YOU WANT.

So you don’t waste another dollar or another year on acting training that isn’t actually advancing you.

👇 Comment TEACHER below and DM me TEACHER.

I’ll send you the Blueprint FREE.

PAID ACTING GIG FOR SHORT FILM

Location: Canoga Park, CA

Shoot date:  TBD, Sometime in October or early November

Hello wonderful actors. I'm shooting a short film and am in need for 2 actors. We need one actor to portray a bounty hunter and the other actor to portray the target or the bounty. It's a basic cat and mouse chase. It will be a 4 hour night shoot at max. We are shooting on 16mm film and will not be recording dialogue or sound. It's all about nonverbal communication, facial expressions and actors business. There will be action, mystery, surprises and a few jump scares. It's a fun script that will be fun for actors to explore some range. If interested, please DM me. 

all the best.

Schauspiersuche
Casting Call
Ich bin Thomas Goersch ein nicht reicher, ein nicht berühmter Filmregisseur aus Deutschland.  
Schaut das Video und vielleicht wollt Ihr in meinem Film mitspielen. 
www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch auf Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Lieben Dank 
Thomas
PS: inzwischen gibt es auch einen Filminhalt und es ergeben sich daraus verschiedene Rollen:
- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 50 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre al

**NOW HIRING IN:**

**• Vancouver, BC**

**• Edmonton, AB**

**• Calgary, AB**

**• Ottawa, ON**

**• Toronto, ON**

**• San Francisco, CA**

**• Seattle, WA**

**Role Snapshot**
* Dates: **October 6–31, 2026**
* Schedule: **Thursday–Sunday, primarily evenings with some weekend afternoon sessions**
* Typical shift: **approximately 3–5 hours**
* Pay: **$26.50 per hour + tips**
* Engagement: **Independent contractor**
* Future work: **strong performers will be offered priority for our December Christmas pop-up experiences**

**About Nightmare Bar**

Nightmare Bar is an immersive Halloween pop-up experience combining themed cocktails, theatrical entertainment, interactive games, challenges, music and a Halloween-inspired atmosphere. Each ticketed session hosts approximately 40–50 guests for a 90-minute experience.

This is more than a standard MC role. We need someone who can command a room, make people laugh, improvise, interact directly with guests and bring a dark, playful Halloween character to life.

**The Role**

As the Lead Nightmare Bar Host, you will run the entertainment experience throughout each session. You will:
* Welcome guests and introduce them to Nightmare Bar
* Host the 90-minute experience
* Run interactive games, challenges, trivia and competitions
* Use a microphone confidently and control the energy of the room
* Move between tables and interact directly with guests
* Improvise and create memorable individual guest moments
* Encourage participation in Nightmare Bar challenges and activities
* Host costume competitions and prize moments
* Activate theatrical elements including the Nightmare telephone experience
* Read and interact with guest confession cards
* Work with music and basic show cues
* Keep the experience running to schedule
* Help reset entertainment props between sessions
* Liaise with the venue and Nightmare Bar team during the shift

* When not on the microphone, the Host should not be standing around waiting for the next activity. You should be moving through the venue, talking to guests, improvising, creating jokes and keeping the Nightmare Bar world alive.

**Who We're Looking For**

Particularly interested in candidates with experience in:
* Live event hosting
* Acting
* Improv comedy
* Immersive theatre
* Trivia or gameshow hosting
* Character entertainment
* Theme parks
* Halloween attractions
* Murder mystery events
* MC / entertainment work
* Interactive hospitality experiences

*Professional acting experience isn't essential. Personality, confidence and the ability to entertain a room matter more. We're looking for the person who can walk into a bar with 50 people, grab a microphone and immediately make everyone want to pay attention.

**Candidate Profile**
* Charismatic and outgoing
* Naturally funny and quick-thinking
* Very comfortable speaking on a microphone
* Comfortable approaching and interacting with strangers
* Strong at improvisation
* Able to read a room and know when to increase or reduce guest interaction
* Reliable and punctual
* Comfortable working in a busy bar environment
* Available Thursday–Sunday throughout the October run, including some weekend afternoons
* Comfortable performing multiple sessions in one shift
* Able to work professionally around alcohol while remaining sober on shift

**Performance Style**

Nightmare Bar is dark, playful, theatrical, funny, immersive and slightly strange. It is not a traditional haunted house.

We are **not** looking for constant screaming, jump scares, gore or aggressive guest interaction. *Think a charismatic,* Halloween host with strong improvisational acting ability, rather than a haunted-house scare actor.

**How to Apply**

Applicants should email the requested information to ashlynn@showtime-presents.com . Please include:
* Name and city
* Recent photo or headshot
* Relevant acting, hosting, improv or entertainment experience
* Confirmation of October 6–31 availability
* A short video introducing yourself and showing your personality

***Bonus*: a 30–60 second video showing how you would welcome a room of guests into a strange Halloween bar. We're looking for performers who can make guests leave saying "the Host absolutely made the experience."

CASTING — dwie osoby, 20-35 lat | okolice Słupska | 20–22.09
Szukamy kobiety i mężczyzny w wieku 20-35 lat do filmu promocyjnego dla jednego z dużych resortów na Pomorzu.

 Ważne: obsadzamy dwie role, ale bohaterowie niekoniecznie występują jako para. Nie trzeba być parą prywatnie ani zgłaszać się we dwójkę. Zgłoszenia indywidualne są jak najbardziej mile widziane.

TERMIN: 20–22 września, realnie ok. 1,5 dnia zdjęciowego

MIEJSCE: okolice Słupska

CZEGO SZUKAMY: naturalności przed kamerą i swobody w pracy z drugą osobą w kadrze. Doświadczenie mile widziane, ale nie jest warunkiem.

WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY (barter):

• weekendowy pobyt w resorcie z wyżywieniem, dla dwojga, osobny dla każdego z aktorów

• zwrot kosztów dojazdu

• materiał będzie wykorzystywany jako film promocyjny w internecie oraz na targach branżowych

• współpraca na podstawie umowy, z zapisem o wykorzystaniu wizerunku

ZGŁOSZENIA: praca@filmmejkers.pl

W mailu prosimy o: imię i nazwisko, wiek, miejscowość, numer telefonu, kilka aktualnych zdjęć (portret oraz cała sylwetka) i link do materiału wideo, jeśli takim dysponujecie.

 Akceptujemy wyłącznie zgłoszenia mailowe. Wiadomości w komentarzach i na priv pozostaną bez odpowiedzi.

Szczegóły produkcji przekazujemy wybranym osobom drogą mailową. Udostępnienie mile widziane

CASTING CALL:
SELF-TAPES

Title: The Art of Making Mistakes

Genre: Drama, Comedy, Student film. 

Logline: The Art of Making Mistakes is a dark comedy that centers on an over productive father, who’s worked hard to provide for his family, and his son, who’s faced the consequences of his absence.

CHARACTERS:

Larry (Early 30s, Hispanic): A machismo father who has spent his whole life building a home for his wife and son, only to realize he’s never actually had time to live in it. Brash. Stuck in his ways.

Xavier (8–12, Hispanic): A young boy forced to write his school report on his macho, enigmatic father. Curious and stubborn. Questions others as much as he questions himself. Where he goes, trouble follows.

Tom (Any race, 40s-50s): A machismo boss at a construction company. Distances himself from co-workers to avoid attachment. Utterly professional. A straight shooter.

Maria (Early 30s, Hispanic): An old-school Hispanic mother. Fiercely protective. The only thread keeping her family intact. Understands that forgiveness and discipline are a balancing act.

Shooting will take place within late October and early November. Filming for 4 to 5 days on the Westminster, CO and Denver, CO area. 

We will provide a meal every day; there will also be snacks and drinks. Once post-production is complete, those involved in the project will be given access to the short.

Email david.renteria@ucdenver.edu for more information.

Questionnaire Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScZbnd6G43o9kvIBCAONBET8JQXmajxk9Ioz_UuqglvcFle6A/viewform

 

Sides Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lqpfE0JoAiuSXBdspj6xwrPvHV3vdvRH?sort=13&direction=a

KTO TAK NAPRAWDĘ PROWADZI TWOJĄ KARIERĘ AKTORSKĄ?

Czy kiedy nie masz zaproszeń na castingi, zaczynasz w siebie wątpić?**

Czy kiedy dostajesz zaproszenia, ale nie wygrywasz castingów, tracisz motywację i masz poczucie, że stoisz w miejscu?

Czy od pół roku planujesz zebrać swoje materiały, przygotować je i wysłać reżyserom castingu i reżyserom — i nadal tego nie zrobiłeś?

Czy masz w głowie całą listę osób, do których miałeś się odezwać — ale mijają kolejne miesiące?

Czy od dawna planujesz zrobić nowe demo i ciągle odkładasz to na później?

Czy zdarza Ci się, że przez kilka dni nie robisz nic dla swojej kariery, bo po prostu **nie wiesz, co konkretnie masz zrobić?**

Czy masz cel aktorski na najbliższe sześć miesięcy i potrafisz powiedzieć, jakie **trzy konkretne rzeczy zrobiłeś w tym tygodniu**, żeby się do niego zbliżyć?

**Czy masz plan na swoją karierę aktorską, czy tak naprawdę czekasz, aż ktoś inny będzie miał plan na Ciebie?**

Jeżeli rozpoznajesz siebie choć w kilku z tych pytań — **zapraszam Cię na bezpłatny webinar dla aktorów.**

Pokażę Ci, jak przestać traktować karierę jako serię przypadkowych castingów i zacząć budować ją świadomie:

**WIZJA → PLAN → KONKRETNE DZIAŁANIA → SYSTEMATYCZNOŚĆ**

Zaczniemy od pytania: **czego naprawdę chcesz od swojej kariery?**

Potem pokażę Ci, jak przełożyć tę wizję na **konkretną ścieżkę działania** — i jak poradzić sobie z tym, co często zabija nawet najlepszy plan: odkładaniem, słomianym zapałem i brakiem konsekwencji.

Pokażę Ci również **LEO — system zarządzania karierą aktorską**, który stworzyłem właśnie po to, żeby pomagał aktorowi przejść od:

**WIZJI → przez ŚCIEŻKĘ → do KONKRETNYCH DZIAŁAŃ.**

Bo nie masz wpływu na wszystko, co wydarzy się w Twojej karierze.

**Ale masz wpływ na to, co robisz dla niej dzisiaj.**

📅 **18 września 2026**
🕖 **19:00**
🎟 **Udział bezpłatny**

Zapisz się teraz. Nie odkładaj tego.
Wyślij maila ze zgłoszeniem na: leo@zarzeczny.eu

 **CASTING CALL — GROOSE | THE LEGEND OF ZELDA: SKYWARD SWORD**

Are you a **Legend of Zelda fan** interested in voice acting? I’m looking for a voice actor to portray **Groose** in a fan-made *The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword* project!

 **ABOUT GROOSE:**

Groose is loud, confident, competitive, and often acts like he’s the toughest guy in Skyloft. Beneath his boastful personality, he has a good heart and genuinely cares about those around him.

**AUDITION INSTRUCTIONS:**

Audition lines will be provided specifically for the character you are auditioning for.

When recording:

• **No slate is necessary.** Begin directly with the audition lines.
• **Stick strictly to the provided lines.**
• **No improvisation.** Do not add or change dialogue.
• **No intention repeats.** Each line should only be performed once.
• Please submit **one complete audio file** containing your entire audition.

Accepted formats: **MP3 or WAV**.
• **Do not send multiple audio attachments.** Your audition must be contained in **one single MP3 or WAV file**.
• Failure to follow these submission requirements will result in the audition being **rejected**.

📅 **AUDITION DEADLINE**

**October 13, 2026**

📩 **SUBMIT YOUR AUDITION**

Send your completed audition as **one MP3 or WAV attachment** to:

**[linkhyrule776@yahoo.ca](mailto:linkhyrule776@yahoo.ca)**

 **PROJECT PRIVACY**

This is a **fan-made project created by fans, for fans.**

To keep the project private during production, **my YouTube channel will not be revealed during casting.**

If you are selected for the role, my YouTube channel and additional project information will be revealed **after production and once you have been chosen for the role.**

Groose's Lines: 
* **On Life Advice:** "My advice? Work hard and wish with all your heart. You might even come in second." 

* **On His Iconic Hairstyle:** "You lay off the do right now, or I'll flatten you. Everyone knows I've got the slickest pompadour in town.

* **On Renaming the Surface World:** "This place needs a name. Yeah... A name fitting for this rugged, adventurous wilderness. From now on, we'll call it... Grooseland!" 

* **On Bullying Link Early On:** "Oh, wait... I got it. You're here to talk about today's race. I can see it in those dopey eyes of yours. They're pleading, 'Oh, Groose, can you please find it in your heart to let me win today? Please!'" 

* **On Dragging the Academy's Name:** "Would you wake up, straighten up, and grow a backbone already? Dopes like you are dragging our honored academy through the mud." 

* **On Stealing Link's Crimson Loftwing:** "Course it was. You thought a big Crimson Loftwing like that was gonna go down without a fight? But we got him... He's not getting out of that pen anytime soon, boys." 
* 
* **On His Redemption and Guarding the Sealed Grounds:** "Nah, don't worry about me. I'm gonna hang back here, Link... Someone's gotta stick around and guard the place. Might as well be me. Besides, if I'm not here, who's gonna look out for the old girl?" 

* **On Rebranding the Entire Game:** "Nice going, you two. You guys were totally amazing in this little adventure I like to call the Legend of Groose. ... That's a little joke."

**CASTING CALL | COUPLES | SUNSHINE COAST, BC**

I’m looking for **two couples** who would love to spend 2–3 nights at a beautiful private oceanfront property on the Sunshine Coast and be part of a television filming and lifestyle content shoot.

Villa Sol in Halfmoon Bay is being featured in a Canadian travel television series on **Tuesday, September 29**, and we’re looking for couples who are natural and comfortable in front of the camera to help bring the experience of the property to life.

**The exchange:**

A complimentary 2–3 night stay at Villa Sol in exchange for participating in the filming and lifestyle content. There is no additional monetary compensation. **Transportation/ferry costs and meals are not included.**

During the filming, you may be captured experiencing different parts of the property — sauna, hot tub, oceanfront, decks, fireside spaces, yoga/sound and other lifestyle moments — as well as some additional Villa Sol photography and video during the stay.

**We’re looking for couples who:**

• Are available September 29 and flexible to be on standby throughout the filming day

• Are comfortable being photographed and filmed, both individually and together

• Feel natural and relaxed on camera

• Are comfortable signing appropriate photo/video releases

• Are happy participating in lifestyle and wellness experiences around the property

• Ideally have an active social media presence and enjoy sharing travel, wellness, nature or lifestyle experiences with their community

The right fit for us is less about traditional modelling experience and more about finding people who genuinely fit the Villa Sol experience and will be comfortable having a fun, relaxed few days while we capture it.

**Interested? Please DM me with:**

• Both of your names and ages

• A recent photo together

• Your social media handles

• Where you’ll be travelling from

• Confirmation that you’re both available September 29

• A little about yourselves and why the experience appeals to you

I’ll be choosing two couples based on overall fit for the property and filming.

Villa Sol is located in **Halfmoon Bay on BC’s Sunshine Coast** and requires ferry travel for those coming from the Vancouver area. 

Please visit [www.solunastays.ca](https://www.solunastays.ca/) to get a sense of the property.

🎬 THE BROS SHOW — FINAL CASTING CALL 🚨
🚨 FINAL CALL FOR SEASON 1 CASTING! 🚨

We’re now entering the final stage of casting for The Bros Show, but we are STILL accepting applications and expressions of interest until the casting decisions are made.

Some roles are heavily contested, some have limited interest, and some are still available.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: Current applicants/people being considered are not officially cast until final decisions are confirmed.

🎭 CURRENT CASTING STATUS

💃 DIVA GIRL — HEAVILY CONTESTED

7+ people currently interested. Still accepting applications.

🚗 DIVA GIRL’S DRIVER — CONTESTED

Multiple people interested. Still accepting applications.

🛡️ DIVA GIRL’S BODYGUARD — JAY CURRENTLY BEING CONSIDERED

💼 SERIOUS BUSINESSMAN — CONTESTED

Around 3 people currently interested.

👮 OFFICER DIXON — VERY LIMITED

Currently only 1 applicant. Casting has not yet been officially confirmed.

👮 OFFICER MALLISON — AVAILABLE

Currently open for applications.

🎤 DRILL AD-LIB GUY — RAYYAN CURRENTLY BEING CONSIDERED

💗 K-POP MANAGER — LIMITED

Currently only 1 person interested.

👩‍🦰 AUNTIES — CONTESTED

Currently receiving interest.

🎬 EPISODE 5 BACKGROUND PERFORMERS — STATUS TBC

Still finalising the requirements, but expressions of interest are welcome.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎥 WHAT IS THE BROS SHOW?

The Bros Show is an independent British comedy series created by Aweys Osman Addo and produced under ABM Records.

The series follows Aweys, Abdi, Aiden and Callum as they attempt to create their own television show while getting themselves into increasingly ridiculous situations.

The show combines:

📺 1990s British sitcom influence

🎥 Mockumentary comedy

😂 Physical comedy

😐 Deadpan reactions

🇬🇧 British humour

📹 Handheld filmmaking

🎭 Scripted scenes + improvisation

🏙️ South London settings

The goal is to create a world that feels bigger than just the four Bros. Recurring characters have their own personalities and lives, occasionally crossing paths with the Bros and getting dragged into the chaos.

🎭 WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Professional acting experience is NOT required.

We’re looking for people with:

• Good comedic timing

• Natural reactions

• Personality

• Confidence

• Strong character commitment

• Chemistry with other performers

• Ability to work from a script

• Willingness to improvise when appropriate

You don’t need to be a traditional theatre actor. A lot of the comedy comes from natural reactions, awkward pauses, facial expressions and timing.

📅 AUDITION DAY

Wednesday 16 September 2026

🕙 Actor arrival/registration: 10:00 AM

🎬 Auditions begin: 10:15 AM

🏁 Scheduled finish: 4:10 PM

Auditions may include short prepared readings and chemistry reads with other performers.

Please allow for potential waiting time depending on attendance.

💰 PRODUCTION TERMS

These are currently unpaid independent-production roles.

Actors will receive:

🍕 Food/refreshments where provided

🎬 Screen credit

📹 Potential footage/showreel opportunities where appropriate

🎭 Experience working on an independent comedy production

There is currently no cash payment available for these roles.

📩 HOW TO APPLY

If you’re interested, send:

• Your name

• Age

• Role you’re interested in

• Location

• Acting/performance experience, if any

• Headshot/photo if available

• Showreel or self-tape if available

A showreel is NOT required.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚨 THIS REALLY IS THE FINAL CALL. 🚨

We’re getting very close to locking the Season 1 cast.

Even if a role already has people interested, you can still express your interest before casting decisions are finalised.

If you think you can bring one of these characters to life, get in touch.

🎬 THE BROS SHOW — SEASON 1

Four bros. One show. Absolutely no plan.

Trust the vision.

And snacks. Never forget the snacks. 🍕

TV Production Partners: Cast, Crew & Investors

Are you a producer with a production studio looking for your next project? I am seeking experienced producers, investors, and industry professionals to help bring a finished TV show script to life.I have a finished TV show script. Now I need the team to make it happen.

I am looking for Producers and Production Studios who can invest in their own content. If you have a studio, a network of cast and crew, and PR connections in the entertainment industry, I want to talk to you.

What I Am Looking For:

Producers/Investors: Individuals or studios with the financial capability to invest in their own TV shows.

Production Studios: Access to your own facilities and resources to produce the project.

Network: Cast and crew who are ready to work on a new series.

PR: Professionals with connections in the entertainment industry to help with distribution and publicity.

If you have the infrastructure and the network to produce a TV series, I have the script. Let’s collaborate. Please answer the membership questions or DM me directly to discuss the project.

CASTING CALL: 1 ACTOR and 1 ACTRESS NEEDED! 

American Playlist Theater (APT) is looking for one actor and one actress to join the cast of our upcoming production:

THE HOLIDAY RADIO THEATER EXTRAVAGANZA 

[https://www.garrisonplayers.org/holiday-radio-extravaganza](https://www.garrisonplayers.org/holiday-radio-extravaganza)

Where: 
Garrison Players Arts Center
Rollinsford, NH

When:
December 4–13, 2026
Fridays at 7:30 PM
Saturdays at 4:00 PM
Sundays at 2:00 PM

Imagine stepping back into the Golden Age of Radio where stand actors at microphones, live Foley sound effects, music, and an announcer, with a live audience enjoying the story.

The Holiday Radio Theater Extravaganza is a collection of original comedic and heartwarming holiday stories, written and directed by Sean Sullivan, presented as a live radio broadcast on stage.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

One actor
One actress

The roles involve playing multiple characters throughout the production, so we're looking for performers who enjoy voice work, character changes, comedy, and ensemble performance.

Experience is NOT required. If you want to perform, like having a good time, or simply want to try something completely different, we'd love to hear from you.

Rehearsals of the shows begin this Tuesday, so jump on board before you'll need to catch up. Come make some Christmas magic with us!

American Playlist Theater Live Radio Theater Reimagined
Learn more about APT and the production at our website [https://americanplaylistth.wixsite.com/website](https://americanplaylistth.wixsite.com/website)

Interested? Send me a message and let's talk!
And if it's not for you...cool! but consider sharing on your page for a friend who might be interested

Sean Sullivan
Writer/Director, American Playlist Theater 
americanplaylisttheater@gmail.com

🎭👩‍👧DZIECIĘCY AKTORZY🤞🎬
## **Dzień dobry!**

Nazywam się Katarzyna Maria Zawadzka. Jestem aktorką oraz trenerką aktorstwa i wystąpień publicznych. 

Wspieram dzieci i młodzież w wieku szkoklnym w przygotowaniu do:

castingów filmowych i reklamowych, konkursów aktorskich, wystąpień publicznych wymagających świadomej autoprezentacji.

Pomagam również w przygotowaniu profesjonalnych wizytówek aktorskich zgodnych z aktualnymi standardami branżowymi oraz w nagrywaniu scen castingowych (self-tape). Prowadzę także regularne lekcje aktorstwa. 

Spotkania z podopiecznymi odbywają się w trybie ON-LINE.

W swojej pracy wspieram również rodziców i opiekunów, zwłaszcza tych, którzy nie są związani z branżą filmową lub teatralną. Pomagam świadomie planować rozwój kariery młodych aktorek i aktorów, podpowiadam, jak odnaleźć się podczas castingów, na jakiej podstawie podejmować trafne decyzje dotyczące współpracy z agencjami i produkcjami oraz jak rozpoznawać potencjalne zagrożenia związane z działalnością w branży.

Brałam udział jako trenerka dziecięcych aktorów przy realizacji między innymi wielokrotnie nagradzanego na festiwalach filmu krótkometrażowego pt.: „Iron Cloud” w reżyserii Nikodema Wojciechowskiego.

Zapraszam do kontaktu! Chętnie odpowiem na pytania i opowiem o możliwościach współpracy dostosowanych do indywidualnych potrzeb młodych aktorów i ich rodziców

Kontakt:
# E-mail: kmzawadzkatrener@gmail.com

[https://www.facebook.com/KMZawadzka](https://www.facebook.com/KMZawadzka)

Poprzez scenki, ruch, zabawę mini musical uczestnicy uczą się racy emocjami, wyrazu scenicznego budowania pewności siebie. 15+ lat pracy dziećmi mini musical wystąpienia publiczne wyraz sceniczny dla dzieci 6-12 lat kameralne grupy Scena zaczyna się od odwagi!'

sharedPost.text:
„Heartaches By The Number“ - ein Klassiker der Countrymusik.

1959 von Harlan Howard geschrieben und von zwei Künstlern fast zeitgleich veröffentlicht: Ray Price und Guy Mitchell (in einer Popversion). Es folgten noch ganz viele Künstler, die das unschöne Thema Liebeskummer in ein fröhliches Gewand gekleidet haben. Auch wir haben uns daran versucht. Was meint Ihr dazu?

Hi All
I’ve been working on this for a while and it’s finally at the point where I’d like some people to try it.

The Actor’s Books is a simple way for supporting artists, actors and performers to keep track of jobs, fees, payments and expenses in one place.

It’s now in public beta. You can try the beta without creating an account, so have a play with it and see what you think.

If you work in the industry, I’d really appreciate any feedback — what works, what doesn’t, or what you think is missing.

theactorsbooks.com

And please feel free to share it with anyone you think might find it useful.

🎬 MARZY WAM SIĘ dzień PEŁEN EMOCJI I DOBREJ ZABAWY? 💙

A może zawsze chcieliście zobaczyć, jak „Milionerzy” wyglądają od kuchni? 👀

Mamy dla Was świetną okazję! 🔥

Zapraszamy Was na nagrania programu „MILIONERZY” i szukamy osób, które chcą zasiąść na naszej wyjątkowej widowni! 🎉

Czeka na Was:

✨ atmosfera telewizyjnego studia

🔥 emocje towarzyszące uczestnikom

🎥 możliwość zobaczenia nagrania programu na żywo

😎 i oczywiście spotkanie z Hubertem!

💰 Za udział w nagraniu przewidziana jest stawka 90 zł, płatna po planie.

📅 Terminy nagrań:

💛 16.09 (środa)

💛 17.09 (czwartek)

💛 18.09 (piątek)

📩 Chcesz dołączyć? To proste!

👉 Zgłoś się przez formularz:

https://forms.gle/EU3FHGy7tCfctTUw5

lub napisz na: ludzie@unagimedia.pl

W tytule maila wpisz: MILIO + wybrana data

W wiadomości podaj:

• imię i nazwisko

• wiek

• numer telefonu

• wyraźne zdjęcie portretowe 📸

👥 Zapraszamy osoby polskojęzyczne!

Możecie zgłaszać się solo albo zabrać ze sobą znajomych, rodzinę czy drugą połówkę. 🫶

🔥 Jeśli chcecie poczuć klimat telewizyjnego studia i przeżyć to na żywo — nie może Was zabraknąć!

**WARSZAWA! **

Na jutro, **16.09**, szukam do statystowania **dziewczyn w wieku 18–28 lat** do nagrań TikToków dla firmy bukmacherskiej.

Co będziecie robić?
— dobrze się bawić
— nagrywać trendy
— być cool 

Stroje: krótkie szorty, topy, stroje kąpielowe — ważne, żebyście czuły się komfortowo podczas nagrań w takich stylizacjach.

**Czas pracy:** około 6 godzin
**Stawka:** 250 zł

Tak, wiem, że to niewysoka stawka — dlatego proszę o kontakt osoby, którym takie warunki odpowiadają.

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o wiadomość prywatną.

**Będzie wesoło!**

🎬 ADULT SCREEN ACTING CLASSES – MANCHESTER 🎬

Want to improve your acting for camera, build your confidence, and get more experience working on screen?

Scene 2 Screen Adult Screen Acting Classes are held every Monday & Tuesday, 7pm–9pm in Manchester and are open to ALL LEVELS — whether you're completely new to acting or already have experience.

🎥 What we cover:�
• Acting for camera�
• Script analysis�
• Self-tape techniques�
• Building confidence on screen
• Industry insight & advice�
• Working with professional scripts

We also regularly bring in industry professionals, including casting directors and directors, for specialist workshops, plus regular agent panels giving you the opportunity to gain valuable insight into the industry.

⭐ BUT HERE'S WHAT REALLY SETS US APART…
Twice during every 4-week block, we film showreel-quality scenes with our students.
You don't just do the scene and forget about it — you get the finished footage to keep and use for your showreel, social media, casting profiles and personal promotion. 🎥

And all of this for just £85 for a 4-week block.

Whether you're looking to get into acting, return to it, sharpen your skills or simply have a go at something new, you'll find a friendly, inclusive and welcoming environment at Scene 2 Screen.

🎬 Monday & Tuesday | 7pm–9pm�📍 Manchester�🎭 All levels welcome�💷 £85 for 4 weeks

📩 Email: Sceen2screenMCR@Gmail.com

AURELLE MODEL MANAGEMENT
International New Face Casting

AURELLE Model Management is currently scouting distinctive female talent aged 18–28 for potential representation and future opportunities within the international fashion industry.

We are looking for individuals with strong presence, individuality and the confidence to bring something unique to the fashion world. We welcome applications from diverse ethnicities, cultures, body types, heights, skin tones, hair textures, facial structures and personal styles.

At AURELLE, difference is not a disadvantage. Your individuality, authenticity and personal identity are what make you memorable.

If you are interested in being considered, please send an email to:

[aurellemodel@gmail.com](mailto:aurellemodel@gmail.com)

Please include:
* Full name
* Age
* Current city and country
* Contact number
* Instagram or social-media profile
* Height
* A brief introduction about yourself
* Recent natural photographs or digitals, including a clear portrait and full-length image

Please ensure that all information submitted is accurate and that photographs are recent, clear and free from heavy filters.

Please arrange to be available for an online callback audition ONLY IF you are selected and notified via email.

All models under the age of 21 must be accompanied during the audition by a parent or legal guardian.

Submitting an application does not guarantee selection or representation. Only selected applicants will be contacted via email.

London | International Talent Scouting

items.text:
Submission due September 18

Open Auditions for Kids “The Sound of Music” on Broadway

Open auditions announced for Oscar & Hammerstein’s musical “The Sound of Music” on Broadway.

Deadline coming up!

This audition notice is for the 2027 season.

The Sound of Music is a musical set in Austria on the eve of World War II. The story follows Maria, a young woman preparing to become a nun who is sent to serve as governess to the seven children of widowed naval captain Georg von Trapp. Through music, warmth, and a strong sense of family, Maria brings new life to the household and eventually falls in love with the captain. The musical features classic songs including “Do-Re-Mi,” “My Favorite Things,” “Edelweiss,” and “Climb Ev’ry Mountain.”

The telsey office released the following casting notice:

Please note that they are taking online audition submissions – However those selected may need to attend in-person auditions in New York.Audition Notice:
OPEN SUBMISSION CALL FOR THE BROADWAY PRODUCTION OF THE SOUND OF MUSIC

Seeking children to play the following roles:

FRIEDRICH VON TRAPP
LOUISA VON TRAPP
KURT VON TRAPP
BRIGITTA VON TRAPP
MARTA VON TRAPP
GRETL VON TRAPP
Audition Notice Details:
THE SOUND OF MUSIC on Broadway 2027 — Seeking Virtual Submissions for von Trapp Children
This Google form is set up to collect submission videos for the six roles that will be played by juvenile actors in the Broadway revival of THE SOUND OF MUSIC at Lincoln Center Theater. These roles are Friedrich, Louisa, Kurt, Brigitta, Marta, and Gretl von Trapp. All juvenile actors should be at least seven years of age by the rehearsal start date of February 1, 2027.

No professional experience necessary to audition. We encourage performers of all gender identities to submit. SEEKING NEW YORK LOCAL HIRES. AUTHORIZATION TO LEGALLY WORK IN THE UNITED STATES IS REQUIRED.

Submissions are due by September 18, 2026.

THE SOUND OF MUSIC

Broadway – Vivian Beaumont Theater
Contract: LORT A+ ($2,244 weekly minimum)
Producer: Lincoln Center Theater (Lear deBessonet, Kewsong Lee Artistic Director; Nicole Kastrinos, Stacey and Eric Mindich Producer)
Book: Howard Lindsay and Russel Crouse
Music: Richard Rodgers
Lyrics: Oscar Hammerstein II
Based on the “The Trapp Family Singers” by Maria Augusta Trapp
Director: Lear deBessonet
Choreographer: Christopher Gattelli
Music Director: Mary-Mitchell Campbell
Casting: The Telsey Office
Rehearsals: February 1, 2027
Previews: March 23, 2027
Opening: April 15, 2027
Scheduled run through: July 18, 2027
____________

SUBMISSION TAPING INSTRUCTIONS:
Material is available at the link below.
THE SOUND OF MUSIC MATERIALS

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/bmn3ut2y4clunnl85wyvv/ADhHUn5luj5T9gLfi7pidYc?rlkey=vd0xnnxgrvwpbr5gd8pyzyehc&st=lqmcy6oc&dl=0

Please record the following (You may submit these as three separate files):

1) A slate that includes your name, your height, where you are currently based, and a full body shot. For those under the age of 18, please state your date of birth. For those auditioning for the roles of MARTA and GRETL, please also verbally confirm that you will be age seven by the rehearsal start date of February 1, 2027.

2) If you are auditioning for the roles of FRIEDRICH or KURT, please prepare the cut of “So Long, Farewell.” If you are auditioning for the roles of LOUISA, BRIGITTA, MARTA, or GRETL, please prepare either “Do-Re-Mi” or “My Favorite Things (Reprise)” — CHOOSE ONE. There are teaching (“plunk”) MP3s for each song to help you learn it. Then when you are ready to record, you should use the accompaniment MP3.

3) Please record one side for the character for which you feel you are best suited.

If you are using an iPhone to video record, please be sure to film horizontally and in a well-lit space (not backlit). Please provide a viewable/downloadable link in the appropriate box below. We are not able to download files (i.e. WeTransfer, Hightail). Dropbox and Google Drive tend to work best (and REMINDER TO MAKE THE SETTINGS ACCESSIBLE TO ANYONE WITH THE LINK — we are not able to request access!). Reminder that YouTube links are not downloadable, so best to avoid YouTube.

For more information on how to submit, please visit the link below:
https://tinyurl.com/THESOUNDOFMUSICLCT2027
Submissions are due by September 18, 2026

**CASTING CALL FOR INDIE MUSIC VIDEO **

Seeking: 25–40 year old WOMAN

Height: Between 5’5” and 5’10” medium to athletic build

Compensation: $150/day

Non-Union

Project: Indie Music Video

We're casting the female lead for a narrative music video exploring the emotional arc of a relationship's collapse. The character moves through the video in three registers: intimate and joyful, volatile and confrontational, and finally distant, almost spectral, as she becomes a haunting presence. This is a physically and emotionally expressive role with no dialogue. The performance carries the story through body language, presence, and a handful of key emotional beats.

Some scenes involve outdoor/wilderness terrain so comfort with hiking and outdoor shoot conditions is a plus.

Who you are:
* Comfortable with emotionally expressive, non-verbal performance (visible rage, tenderness, indifference/contempt)
* Comfortable on outdoor/wilderness terrain, including moderate hiking with light gear
* Prior acting/modeling experience preferred but not required 

If interested, send me an email to **mm.volcano.casting@gmail.com **with your self tape and head shot, height and any relevant acting/modeling experience

**Deadline for submissions: Monday, 21 September 2026**

items.text:
After our summer break Chromolume Theatre is back with the breakdown for our final show of our 2026 Season of Identity and Expression, the first fully staged production of the Sondheim/Weidman musical Road Show, directed by Joanna Syiek with musical direction by Richard Berent!  (Note: this is very much an ensemble show, with strong singer/actor/performers needed.)

As always, please submit ALL ETHNICITIES FOR ALL ROLES!

Synopsis: Road Show is a tale of dreamers, based on the true story of the Mizner Brothers, who scramble for success, identity and love at the turn of the twentieth century.

Director: Joanna Syiek

Musical Director: Richard Berent

Audition Date(s): 09/26/2026, 09/27/2026

Callback Date(s): 09/30/2026

Rehearsal Date(s): 10/05/2026, 10/12/2026 to 11/18/2026

Preview Date(s): 11/19/2026

Opening Date(s): 11/20/2026

Closing Date(s): 12/06/2026

Location: The Zephyr Theatre

Rate: $400 honorarium, $300 for Understudies

SUBMIT ELECTRONICALLY: Email headshot & resume to casting@chrtheatre.com, NO VIDEO SUBMISSIONS

SPECIAL NOTE: Auditions are by invitation only and not all submissions will be brought in for an audition. You will be asked to please prepare a 16-32 bar selection of song in the style of the show.  NO WEBBER. An Accompanist will be provided. Bring sheet music in the correct key and cut to length ideally showing the range of the character for which you are auditioning.  Non-AEA

THERE WILL BE UNDERSTUDIES CAST FOR THE ROLES OF WILSON, AND ADDISON, RESPECTIVELY WITH TWO GUARANTEED PERFORMANCES.

Addison: Male Presenting, 30-50. The levelheaded brother living in the shadows of Wilson's schemes. A visionary artist with flair and guile. Cares for his mother. Not as prone to seizing the world as his brother. Easily influenced by his older brother.  Vocal Range: G5-F3.

Wilson: Male Presenting, 30-50. Handsome and charming. Always has a good time, but also lowlife con artist involved in a series of scams. Lives his life as one big, adventurous attempt to seize opportunity. The greedy, selfish brother to Addison.  Vocal Range: A5-F3.

Hollis Bessemer: Male Presenting, 25-30. An honest businessman who rejects the family business to build his dream of an artist colony. Partners with Addison to create an extremely successful real estate business and finally a fortune of his own. Sensitive. Loves Addison. Vocal Range: G5-B3.

Mama: Female Presenting, 50-65. Mother to Addison and Wilson. Encourages her sons to follow opportunity by any means necessary. Coddles Wilson, whom she clearly favors, and ultimately loses him to his own greed. Depends on Addison to take care of her. Vocal Range: E5-G3.

**Title**: Clear Eyed

**Genre**: (Drama, Horror, Tragedy.)

**Logline**: A young man struggles to hold onto his sanity as the silent image of his dead, schizophrenic brother haunts him whenever the bandages covering his missing eye are off.

**Roles**

*Drew* - Male, Early 20s: A sweet but reserved young man. He tries his best to handle his problems alone, but after losing his eye in an accident, his hallucinations get out of control. Now he's struggling to hold on to his sanity.

*Alice *- Female, Late 20s: Drew’s supportive and put together older sister. She’s lost a lot of family to this mental illness and can’t lose anyone else. She’s trying her best to keep Drew safe, but is it enough?

*Justin* - Male, Early 20s The hallucination of Drew’s dead older brother. He’s ghostly pale with a bloody bruise from a noose around his neck. The shell of their brother is a silent reminder of the illness plaguing the family.

**Production Company**: Director - Holly Mathews, Writer/Producer: Theo Henderson

**Production Type**: Student Film

**Contact Information**: email - [theo.b.henderson@gmail.com](mailto:theo.b.henderson@gmail.com) 

Casting Form - [https://forms.gle/HiJyrYaKQEuBmmwb8](https://forms.gle/HiJyrYaKQEuBmmwb8) 

**Run Time**: Short 

**Compensation**: Paid, Drew - $300, Alice - $250, Justin - $100

**Union Status**:  Non-Union, etc

**Audition Information**: We are closing auditions on September 25th. 

**Shooting Schedule**: October 16th-18th and October 23rd-35th

**Filming Location**: Denver

# **CASTING CALL: Seeking actors for a queer ghost short film!**

Title: Dead Gaze (formerly Another Gaze as casting will reflect)

Genre: Drama and Horror(loosely

Logline: A struggling creative tries again and again to create their queer ghost investigation tv show with no luck, until they meet a woman at the bar who might be the solution to all their problems.

**CHARACTERS:**

**Billy** (LEADING 19-26 Androgynous/Fem Nonbinary Person): A young person trying to make a new queer ghost show.

**Mary** (LEADING 25-34 White Female) A mature woman dressed in 1950's attire who helps Billy while longing for her dead lover.

**Joanne** (SUPPORTING 25-35 Butch Female) A butch woman in a secret relationship with Mary.

**Husband** (SUPPORTING 25-38 White Male) Mary's husband who catches her with her secret lover.

**Bartender** (SUPPORTING 20-58 Male) A kind man who loves to listen and tell stories with his customers.

**LOCATIONS, PAY, DATES, ETC.**
* Filming will be in the greater Denver area, but exact locations are TBD
* ALL ROLES WILL BE UNPAID! We are juniors in college making this film as a part of our program, so all crew in general will be unpaid
* MEALS will be provided
* Personal transportation would be preferred (we will pay gas), but we can try to work things out if needed
* Our shoot dates are currently October 23rd, 24th, and 25th (with a potential pickup day the next weekend, likely November 1st, but for sure no Halloween)

This is a non union shoot.

Here is the link to our sides and audition form: [https://linktr.ee/knightcyleigh](https://linktr.ee/knightcyleigh)

If you have any other questions, please email knightcyleigh@gmail.com

## **CASTING CALL FOR FEATURE FILM - CHEDDAR POP **

What started as a proof of concept short, has blown up to a full feature shoot!  “Cheddar Pop", is an independent, privately funded, feature that I wrote and will be producing from the ground up this year. It’s a comedy about a group of young movie theater workers who learn to rely on themselves and each other as they attempt to unionize their workplace.  We only succeed, together. 

Feature Film: “Cheddar Pop”

Location: Greater Aurora, CO. Area. Exact locations TBD

Shoot Dates: Now through December (**Extreme Schedule Flexibility a must since we will be filming in live business locations.)**

Project Type: Independent Feature Film (non-union, yes, we get the irony here)

Compensation: Unpaid, (for now) meals provided. Proportional cast profit splits when sold. 

Genre: Comedy

Logline: A group of theater employees find solidarity as they attempt to unionize their workplace and return to what made Cheddar’s Cinema a great place to work. Taking a stand at the concessions stand!

Roles available for any age or any level of experience. Character Descriptions and number of scenes here : [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cAiAADfijNUpa9gNIxYqcP_g9JSIlx3KaBN0TLwOVCw/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cAiAADfijNUpa9gNIxYqcP_g9JSIlx3KaBN0TLwOVCw/edit?usp=sharing) 

Email cheddarpopmovie@gmail.com for sides and Audition Notes. Submissions due by September 25, 2026. See less

A może zawsze chcieliście zobaczyć, jak „Milionerzy” wyglądają od kuchni? 👀

Mamy dla Was świetną okazję! 🔥

Zapraszamy Was na nagrania programu „MILIONERZY” i szukamy osób, które chcą zasiąść na naszej wyjątkowej widowni! 🎉

Czeka na Was:

✨ atmosfera telewizyjnego studia

🔥 emocje towarzyszące uczestnikom

🎥 możliwość zobaczenia nagrania programu na żywo

😎 i oczywiście spotkanie z Hubertem!

💰 Za udział w nagraniu przewidziana jest stawka 90 zł, płatna po planie.

💛 16.09 (środa)

💛 18.09 (piątek)

• imię i nazwisko

• wiek

• numer telefonu

• wyraźne zdjęcie portretowe 📸

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 38/2026

GIFTSCHRANKFILM SCHAFFT ES DOCH INS KINO, REBOOT EINER ZOCKERREIHE

Jahrelang wartete COYOTE VS ACME nach dessen Fertigstellung auf einen Kinostart. Nun ist es soweit und die Looney Tones feiern ihr Leinwandcomeback.

Eines der beliebtesten Games der ersten Playstation Versionen wurde erstmals 2002 ins Kino gebracht. Dieser Tage startet mit dem Reboot von RESIDENT EVIL eine neue Zeitrechnung. Ob es sich lohnt, dafür ein Kinoticket zu kaufen, erfahren Sie in unserer Sendung. 

Ihn treibt die Freude am bewegten Bild an. Für ihn ist es auch das Schaffens eines Zeitdokumentes. Sarah Fuchs mit Manfred Neugebauer über seine Arbeit und seine Passion.

Musikalisch gibt es ein Best of der beliebtesten Moviesongs der letzten Jahre.

ÉDIT : Trouvés merci !! 🙂

URGENT : recherche H/F 25/55 ans en figuration pour le SAMEDI 19 SEPTEMBRE sur MERIEL( 95 )ayant déjà eu des expériences en tant que POMPIERS ou PTS/TIC( en tournage ou en vrai 😉 )
( priorité aux comédien( nes ), pas de candidature en MP et merci de VRAIMENT lire attentivement l’annonce jusqu’au bout avant de postuler 🙏🏻 )!

Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Dans le cadre du tournage d’une mini série pour une plate-forme je recherche des H et des F entre 25 et 55( âge apparent ), ayant connaissance des gestes des pompiers ou des PTS/TIC.

Tournage ce SAMEDI 19 SEPTEMBRE à MERIEL( 95 accessible en BUS ou TRAIN, pas de défraiement transport de prévu malheureusement donc on cherche des gens autonomes en transports ou véhiculés ): 
Horaires prévisionnels : 08h00/19h30( mais vous ne tournerez certainement que le matin ).

Merci de ne pas postuler si vous ne faites pas de figuration, d’indiquer vos disponibilités/indisponibilités entre le 16 SEPTEMBRE et le 14 OCTOBRE.

Pour tous : il est impératif d’être autonomes pour se rendre sur le décor( et en repartir ).
Pas de défraiement transport de prévu, je cherche des personnes vivant à proximité de MERIEL( ou souhaitant venir à leurs frais, ou en covoiturage 🙂 ).

Rémunération : cachet 98 euros bruts( base 8h + 1h de repas )+ éventuelles heures sup/heures de nuit si il y a

Si vous êtes intéressé(e)s, disponibles, que vous correspondez aux critères et que vous N’AVEZ PAS D’IMPÉRATIF HORAIRE sur le ou les jours pour lesquels vous postulez, merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : 

Uas.casting@gmail.com

IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le décor avec la date pour laquelle vous postulez + votre spécificité, votre âge, NOM + Prénom, mensurations :  exemple «   19 SEPTEMBRE POMPIER, Sophie MARTINEZ 25 ans, 1m75, 60kg » ou «  19 SEPTEMBRE PTS, Kevin CHAPUIS 35 ans , 1m85, 85kg, etc… 

Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre si possible les éléments suivants :
-Vos indisponibilités( ou disponibilités )entre le 16 SEPTEMBRE et le 14 OCTOBRE
-VOS MENSURATIONS COMPLÈTES( taille, poids, veste, haut, pantalon, chaussures ) 
-Origines ethniques 
-Couleur des yeux
-Couleur des cheveux 
- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)
- NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE 
-Date et lieu de naissance 
-Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )
-2 à 3 photos de vous récentes( dont portrait, en pied et un selfie pris aujourd’hui, sans filtre )
-Préciser si vous avez des expériences de service, des compétences particulières quelles qu’elles soient( ancien pompier par exemple etc etc )
-Préciser si vous avez des tatouages, des piercings, des cheveux colorés etc.. 
-Préciser, si vous le souhaitez, si vous avez eu recours à la chirurgie esthétique 
-Préciser si vous avez des tenues très chic/luxe/gala. N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues si vous le pouvez !
-Préciser si vous disposez de tenues en rapport avec de futurs potentiels décors( serveurs, sécu etc … )
N’hésitez pas à joindre des photos de vous en tenues si vous avez.
-Préciser toutes les langues que vous parlez et le niveau et tout accent spécifique que vous pourriez avoir 
-Un CV et une bande démo( si vous avez )pour mon fichier et pour d’éventuelles silhouettes.
-N’hésitez pas à préciser si vous avez des talents particuliers : cascade, sport à haut niveau, musicien, danseur, etc etc 
-Préciser si vous êtes autonomes et par quel moyen( voiture, scooter, vélo, trottinette etc )
-Préciser si vous êtes ok pour faire du co voiturage pour les personnes disposant d’une voiture
-Préciser la marque et la couleur de votre voiture 
-Des photos de votre voiture, scooter, vélo etc pour celles et ceux qui en ont.

Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous re contacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond. 

Merci par avance à toutes et à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée ! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais
Uas.casting@gmail.com

CASTING CALL | PAID PHOTOSHOOT | COLORADO SPRINGS

Axis is casting grandparents and teens/young adults for a lifestyle photoshoot celebrating the relationship between grandparents and their grandchildren.

Date: Thursday, September 24
Location: Colorado Springs, CO
Time: Approximately 2-hour windows
Pay: $200 flat rate per person
PHOTOSHOOT ONLY. No video or dialogue.

Seeking:
• Grandmas & Grandpas, ages 60–75
• Teens/young adults, ages 14–20
• A variety of ethnicities and family backgrounds

Photos will feature natural moments like baking together, playing games, reading the Bible, playing chess, celebrating a graduation, cheering at a football game, and working on a car.

Real grandparents and grandchildren are encouraged to submit together, but you do not need to be related. No professional experience required.

To submit: Email irene@axis.org with your name, age, current photo/headshot, phone number, and availability on September 24. If submitting together, please include information and photos for each person.

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 & 𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋

Hey there, our lovely industry! I’m entering the second phase of Pre-Production and I’m still needing some help for our Thriller Short Indie Film, Cartyr!
𝙈𝙤𝙧𝙚 𝙨𝙤 𝙤𝙣 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙘𝙧𝙚𝙬 𝙨𝙞𝙙𝙚 <—
𝙗𝙪𝙩 𝙤𝙥𝙚𝙣 𝙨𝙥𝙤𝙩𝙨 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙘𝙖𝙨𝙩

Logline: After being convicted and sent to a psychiatric institution, a mass-murdering serial killer is brought in for another mandated therapy session with his doctor—but this time, something is different.

ᴀʙᴏᴜᴛ ᴛʜᴇ ᴘʀᴏᴊᴇᴄᴛ
Production Type: Independent Short Film
Genre: Horror / Thriller
Runtime: Approximately 10 minutes
Filming Window: The 2nd-3rd Week of October.
Location: Colorado Springs, CO.

This is currently an unpaid independent project. Food will be provided during filming, and all cast and crew will receive full film credits and IMDb credit.

The production is expected to require 2–3 days of filming, with the majority of scenes taking place indoors.

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋 
Young Cartyr
Age: 8-14
Physical Description:
- Brown Hair
- Hazel eyes hopefully but Green/Brown Eyes work too. 
- Mixed Hispanic/Caucasian.
Role: Supporting
I need a young performer who fits a younger version of me. He must appear hollow, falsely empathetic, cold but not fully unnerving yet at this time in his life. Must be careful with loud performances and things being thrown about.

The Victims
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Number Needed: 3
Role: Background / Supporting
Three performers needed to loom over the scene and, through body language and physical presence, showing that they silently despise what they see in front of them.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

Extras
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Background
Various victims who will appear briefly throughout intense scenes.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

morelandcreativearts@gmail.com

This film shall either be set on a weekend of the 2nd or 3rd week October. This casting call is currently for pre-production and early recruitment purposes.

Thank you for your help!

items.text:
🎭 NOT ALL ACTING TRAINING WILL GET YOU CLOSER TO BOOKING WORK.
And you might not even realise it.

If you’ve been taking acting classes for months or even years, but you’re still struggling with your confidence, technique or ability to apply what you’re learning…

Your teacher might not be the right teacher for you.

⚠️ Here are 3 BIG red flags I’d pay VERY close attention to:

1. You’re performing scenes and receiving criticism, but you’re not being TRAINED to improve.

A teacher can critique your scene every week, but if they aren’t giving you the exercises and techniques to develop your overall ability as an actor, that’s criticism, not training.

2. You’re not seeing meaningful growth in your acting, which is holding you back from becoming the extraordinary actor you’re capable of becoming with the right training.

🚨 3. Your acting teacher has never built a successful working career as an actor: How can you be confident that what you’re being taught will help you BOOK WORK if your teacher has never built a successful career themselves?

These are the kinds of red flags that can make you waste months (and thousands of dollars) on training that isn’t moving you forward.

So I created the FREE Acting Teacher Blueprint.

Inside, I’ll show you exactly what kind of training will help you BOOK WORK, so you don’t waste another dollar or another year on acting training that isn’t advancing you.

👇 Comment TEACHER below and DM me TEACHER.

I’ll send you the Blueprint FREE.
